title: Sp100A isoform promotes localization of the histone chaperone HIRA to PML nuclear bodies.
authors: Della Fera, Ashley N; Arman, Warda; Powers, Maceo E; Cachau, Raul E; Warburton, Alix; McBride, Alison A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Sp100A介导HIRA组蛋白伴侣定位至PML核体，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关染色质动态，但核心非TF-DNA结合，且AI/MD仅用于辅助结构预测，方法深度有限。
abstract: PML nuclear bodies (PML-NBs) are dynamic subnuclear structures important for chromatin dynamics and anti-viral defense. In this study we investigate the role of Sp100 isoforms in promoting localization of the H3.3 histone chaperone HIRA to PML-NBs in human keratinocytes. Sp100 knockout (KO) cell lines were generated in normal keratinocytes using CRISPR-Cas9 technology and shown to display typical skin development, normal PML-NB formation, and a normal interferon response as determined by RNAseq. However, the histone chaperone HIRA and its associated complex members (Ubinuclein-1 and ASF1A) failed to localize to PML-NBs in the absence of Sp100, even after interferon stimulation. Exogenous expression of the four main isoforms of Sp100 showed that the Sp100A isoform is the primary driver of HIRA localization to PML-NBs; predictive structural analysis of the various Sp100 isoforms using several AI methods (AlphaFold 3, Chai-1, and Boltz-2) plus molecular dynamics simulation of Sp100B highlighted how interspersed structural domains and intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) could influence this localization. Analysis of Sp100A proteins with mutations in seven distinct functions showed that the SUMO-interacting motif (SIM) plays an important role in HIRA localization to PML-NBs. These findings highlight the functional diversity of the Sp100 isoforms in modulating chromatin dynamics at PML-NBs and further discern the molecular features underpinning the relationship between histone chaperones and PML-NBs. We conclude that HIRA recruitment to PML-NBs is not required for immediate interferon signaling but as suggested by others, is potentially required for maintaining epigenetic memory by delayed H3.3 incorporation at interferon-stimulated genes.
abstract_zh: PML核体（PML-NBs）是动态的亚核结构，对染色质动力学和抗病毒防御至关重要。在本研究中，我们探讨了Sp100异构体在促进H3.3组蛋白伴侣HIRA定位至人角质形成细胞PML-NBs中的作用。利用CRISPR-Cas9技术在正常角质形成细胞中生成了Sp100敲除（KO）细胞系，并显示其具有典型的皮肤发育、正常的PML-NB形成以及正常的干扰素反应（通过RNAseq确定）。然而，在缺乏Sp100的情况下，组蛋白伴侣HIRA及其相关复合物成员（Ubinuclein-1和ASF1A）未能定位至PML-NBs，即使在干扰素刺激后也是如此。四种主要Sp100异构体的外源表达表明，Sp100A异构体是HIRA定位至PML-NBs的主要驱动因素；使用多种AI方法（AlphaFold 3、Chai-1和Boltz-2）对Sp100各异构体进行的预测性结构分析，以及对Sp100B的分子动力学模拟，突显了散布的结构域和 intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) 如何影响这种定位。对具有七种不同功能突变的Sp100A蛋白分析显示，SUMO相互作用基序（SIM）在HIRA定位至PML-NBs中发挥重要作用。这些发现强调了Sp100异构体在调节PML-NBs处染色质动力学中的功能多样性，并进一步阐明了组蛋白伴侣与PML-NBs之间关系的分子特征。我们得出结论，HIRA招募至PML-NBs并非即时干扰素信号传导所必需，但正如其他研究所建议的，可能通过延迟H3.3掺入干扰素刺激基因来维持表观遗传记忆。
